_notes: Flashlight fish night group (Anomalops katoptron), a second components/School built by ReefTank from config/scene.json population.nightSchoolUri and each density's nightSchool { lane, count }. Same parameters and meaning as config/school.json (read its _notes), tuned looser and slower: the fish cruise as a scattered group (wider sepRadius and minDist, weaker cohesion and alignment, larger boundRadius) rather than a tight school. The species is nightOnly (config/species/flashlight_fish.json night block), so the members are invisible by day and fade in with the night level; the school logic runs either way so the group never jumps. ReefTank replaces lane, ellipses and count.
